svg.title: PLANNING GUIDE: ACCESSIBLE WC

g.text: ACCESSIBLE WC FOR VISITORS AND STAFF

svg.text: BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 §, 3 kap. 7 §; old BBR (BFS 2011:6) 3:1453 allmänt råd (repealed)
accessible WC required, transfer both sides, old 2.2 × 2.2 m advice — https://rinfo.boverket.se/BFS2024-12/pdf/BFS2024-12.pdf
AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 4 § p. 6, 56-58 §§ (1/15 and 2.2 x 2.2 m are allmänt råd = guidance)
2.2 × 2.2 m room, alarm and contrast, 1 per floor, 1 WC per 15 employees — https://www.av.se/globalassets/filer/publikationer/foreskrifter/utformning-av-arbetsplatser-afs2023-12.pdf
AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 58 § allmänna råd: an accessible toilet should be at least 2.2 x 2.2 m (4.84 m2). The same figure was in repealed BBR
3:1453 (repealed BBR, pre-2025). BFS 2024:12 itself gives no room size.
